'''Jennifer S. Brodbelt''' is an [[Americans|American]] [[chemist]] known for her research using mass spectrometry to characterize organic compounds, especially [[biopolymer]]s and [[protein]]s.

== Education and career ==
Brodbelt has an undergraduate degree from the [[University of Virginia]] and earned her Ph.D. from [[Purdue University]] where she worked on gas phase ion chemistry using mass spectrometry.<ref>{{cite thesis |last=Brodbelt-Lustig |first= Jennifer Sue |date=1998 |title= Aspects of ion chemistry in mass spectrometry|type=Ph.D. |chapter= |publisher= |docket= |oclc= 
|url=https://purdue.primo.exlibrisgroup.com/permalink/01PURDUE_PUWL/ufs51j/alma99170054299801081 |access-date=October 6, 2021}}</ref> Following her Ph.D. she was a postdoc at the [[University of California, Santa Barbara]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Postdoctoral Research Fellowship in Chemistry |access-date=28 August 2024 |language=en |url=https://grantome.com/grant/NSF/CHE-8808047}}</ref> before joining the [[University of Texas at Austin]] in 1989.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Jennifer S. Brodbelt - Professor of Biochemistry and Molecular Genetics in Austin, Texas, United States Of America {{!}} eMedEvents|url=https://www.emedevents.com/speaker-profile/jennifer-s-brodbelt|access-date=2021-10-06|website=eMedEvents.com|language=en}}</ref> As of 2016, she is the Roland Pettit Centennial Chair in the Department of Chemistry.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Faculty|url=http://catalog.utexas.edu/undergraduate/natural-sciences/faculty/|publisher=utexas.edu|accessdate=December 13, 2016}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Jennifer Brodbelt|url=http://www.cnm.utexas.edu/faculty/jennifer-brodbelt/|publisher=utexas.edu|accessdate=December 13, 2016|archive-date=December 20, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161220195520/http://www.cnm.utexas.edu/faculty/jennifer-brodbelt/|url-status=dead}}</ref> 

She was the president of the [[American Society for Mass Spectrometry]] from 2014 to 2016.<ref name="urlPast Presidents">{{cite web|title=Past Presidents|url=https://www.asms.org/about/asms-leadership/past-presidents|format=|accessdate=2019-04-19}}</ref> 

== Research ==
Brodbelt's research centers on the development of [[mass spectrometry]]-based methods to characterize organic molecules.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Brodbelt|first=Jennifer S.|date=1997|title=Analytical applications of ion-molecule reactions|url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/%28SICI%291098-2787%281997%2916%3A2%3C91%3A%3AAID-MAS3%3E3.0.CO%3B2-4|journal=Mass Spectrometry Reviews|language=en|volume=16|issue=2|pages=91–110|doi=10.1002/(SICI)1098-2787(1997)16:2<91::AID-MAS3>3.0.CO;2-4|bibcode=1997MSRv...16...91B |issn=1098-2787|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=2019|title=Jennifer Brodbelt|url=https://theanalyticalscientist.com/powerlist/2019/jennifer-brodbelt|access-date=2021-10-06|website=The Analytical Scientist|language=en}}</ref> Brodbelt's early research established methods to use [[chemical ionization]] in ion trap mass spectrometers<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Brodbelt|first1=Jennifer S.|last2=Louris|first2=John N.|last3=Cooks|first3=R. Graham.|date=1987-05-01|title=Chemical ionization in an ion trap mass spectrometer|url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/pdf/10.1021/ac00136a007|journal=Analytical Chemistry|volume=59|issue=9|pages=1278–1285|doi=10.1021/ac00136a007|issn=0003-2700|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Brodbelt|first1=Jennifer.|last2=Liou|first2=Chien Chung.|last3=Donovan|first3=Tracy.|date=1991-07-01|title=Selective adduct formation by dimethyl ether chemical ionization in a quadrupole ion trap mass spectrometer and a conventional ion source|url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/pdf/10.1021/ac00013a005|journal=Analytical Chemistry|volume=63|issue=13|pages=1205–1209|doi=10.1021/ac00013a005|issn=0003-2700|url-access=subscription}}</ref> and applied this method to the analysis of petroleum samples.<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Brodbelt|first1=Jennifer S.|last2=Cooks|first2=R. Graham|last3=Wood|first3=Karl V.|last4=Jackson|first4=Thomas J.|date=1986-01-01|title=The Analysis of Metalloporphyrins in Petroleum Using Tandem Mass Spectrometry|url=https://doi.org/10.1080/08843758608915836|journal=Fuel Science and Technology International|volume=4|issue=6|pages=683–698|doi=10.1080/08843758608915836|bibcode=1986FSTI....4..683B |issn=0884-3759|url-access=subscription}}</ref> She subsequently worked on [[gas-phase ion chemistry]]<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Brodbelt|first1=J. S.|last2=Liou|first2=C.-C.|date=1993-01-01|title=New frontiers in host-guest chemistry: The gas phase|journal=Pure and Applied Chemistry|language=de|volume=65|issue=3|pages=409–414|doi=10.1351/pac199365030409|s2cid=31322707 |issn=1365-3075|doi-access=free}}</ref> and [[photodissociation]]<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Brodbelt|first1=Jennifer S.|last2=Wilson|first2=Jeffrey J.|date=2009|title=Infrared multiphoton dissociation in quadrupole ion traps|url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/mas.20216|journal=Mass Spectrometry Reviews|language=en|volume=28|issue=3|pages=390–424|doi=10.1002/mas.20216|pmid=19294735 |bibcode=2009MSRv...28..390B |issn=1098-2787|url-access=subscription}}</ref> as methods to break apart organic compounds before they are analyzed by a mass spectrometer. Her work has led to the analysis of compounds including recreational drugs,<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Hall|first1=Brad J|last2=Brodbelt|first2=Jennifer S|date=1997-08-15|title=Determination of barbiturates by solid-phase microextraction (SPME) and ion trap gas chromatography–mass spectrometry|url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0021967397003634|journal=Journal of Chromatography A|language=en|volume=777|issue=2|pages=275–282|doi=10.1016/S0021-9673(97)00363-4|pmid=9299725 |issn=0021-9673|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Hall|first1=Brad J.|last2=Satterfield-Doerr|first2=Mary|last3=Parikh|first3=Aashish R.|last4=Brodbelt|first4=Jennifer S.|date=1998-05-01|title=Determination of Cannabinoids in Water and Human Saliva by Solid-Phase Microextraction and Quadrupole Ion Trap Gas Chromatography/Mass Spectrometry|url=https://doi.org/10.1021/ac971228g|journal=Analytical Chemistry|volume=70|issue=9|pages=1788–1796|doi=10.1021/ac971228g|pmid=9599579 |issn=0003-2700|url-access=subscription}}</ref> sunscreen,<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Felix|first1=Tonya|last2=Hall|first2=Brad J|last3=S. GC–MS|url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0003267098002931|journal=Analytica Chimica proteins<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Shaw|first1=Jared B.|last2=Li|first2=Wenzong|last3=Holden|first3=Dustin D.|last4=Zhang|first4=Yan|last5=Griep-Raming|first5=Jens|last6=Fellers|first6=Ryan == Awards ==
She was awarded the [[Agnes Fay Morgan Research Award]] in 1995.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-10-06|title=Past Award Winners {{!}} Iota Sigma Pi|url=https://www.iotasigmapi.org/past-award-winners|access-date=2021-10-06|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211006120359/https://www.iotasigmapi.org/past-award-winners |archive-date=2021-10-06 }}</ref> In 2019, Brodbelt received the Frank H. Field and Joe L. Franklin Award for Outstanding Achievement in Mass Spectrometry from the [[American Chemical Society]].<ref>{{Cite journal|date=2017-01-02|title=Frank H. Field & Joe L. Franklin Award for Outstanding Achievement in Mass Spectrometry: Vicki H. Wysocki|journal=C&EN Global Enterprise|volume=95|issue=1|pages=49–50|doi=10.1021/cen-09501-awards054|issn=2474-7408|doi-access=free}}</ref> In 2023, she was named one of the "Mentors and Educators" in the Power List by the Analytical Scientist.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-09-10 |title=The Power List 2023 |url=https://theanalyticalscientist.com/power-list/2023 |access-date=2023-09-02 |website=The Analytical Scientist |language=en}}</ref> In 2024, she was awarded the Thomson Medal by the [[International Mass Spectrometry Foundation]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-07-23 |title=IMSF AWARDS - 25th International Mass Spectrometry Convention |url=https://imsc2024melbourne.com/imsf-awards/ |access-date=2024-08-24 |website=imsc2024melbourne.com |language=en-AU}}</ref>
